news.title: Sobha’s net profit declines 55% to ₹32.95 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Sobha reported a 54.6 percent decline in net profit after tax for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company's total income also fell by 30.8 percent compared to the same period last year. However, real estate sales value increased by 16 percent year-on-year during the quarter. For the first half of FY27, Sobha achieved record sales value and positive collections.

news.title: UltraTech Cement's profit rises 21.3% to ₹1,501 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: During the September quarter, UltraTech Cement reported an impressive 21.27% increase in consolidated profit, reaching Rs 1,501.38 crore. This growth was fueled by an 18.81% rise in operational revenue, thanks to enhanced sales volumes and effective cost management. Domestic grey cement sales surged by 13.8%, solidifying the company's position in a competitive market, even as total expenses climbed by 18.44%.

news.title: Panchkula: 18-acre illegal colony razed in Golpura
news.para: On Sunday, a significant demolition operation unfolded in Golpura village as the district town planning department removed unauthorized structures in an illegal colony covering 18 acres. Under the leadership of DTP Babita Gupta, the operation was fortified by a strong police presence for safety. Officials reiterated that developing colonies requires prior approval and warned of ongoing enforcement against illegal construction throughout the district to address unauthorized colonization.

news.title: Farmers give consent, New Noida land acquisition set to begin soon
news.para: The Noida Authority is preparing to initiate land acquisition for New Noida, with 281 farmers already consenting to part with their plots. Finalized acquisition rates for the ambitious Dadri-Noida-Ghaziabad Investment Region, covering more than 20,000 hectares, are now in place. Planned in four phases, the aim is to secure 3,165 hectares by 2027.

news.title: Over 110 families in Kot Sekhon get property cards under ‘Mera Ghar, Mere Naam’ Scheme
news.para: Punjab cabinet minister Tarunpreet Singh Sond recently handed out property cards to 115 beneficiaries in Kot Sekhon village. This initiative aims to legally empower families who previously lacked clear ownership documentation. Utilizing surveys and digital mapping, these records will facilitate smoother access to bank loans and enhance future property transactions for generations to come.

news.title: Most stilt+four approvals in Gurugram-Manesar came before July 2024, Haryana government tells HC
news.para: The Department of Town and Country Planning has set the record straight, stating that over 60% of building plans received approval prior to the introduction of new guidelines. They refuted claims made by the petitioner regarding nearly 30,000 approvals granted since July 2024, asserting that these figures were inaccurately calculated based on earlier approval assumptions.

news.title: Telangana RERA orders BVR Infra Developers to refund ₹10.95 lakh with 10.7% annual interest
news.para: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has ordered BVR Infra Developers to return ₹10.95 lakh to two purchasers who made payments for plots in SV Golden City-III but received nothing in return. The developer's failure to meet essential RERA registration standards was highlighted, and they chose not to attend the hearings.

news.title: Telangana RERA orders penalty proceedings over sale of 40 plots without registration
news.para: Sivom Projects has been flagged by the Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority for illegally selling plots without the required RERA registration, violating essential regulations. The authority has issued penalties against the managing director and relevant parties. Complaints from buyers regarding inadequate infrastructure and encroachment on their properties have surfaced. However, the authority has opted not to enforce project completion amidst pending court cases.

news.title: Ventive Hospitality in talks to acquire 2-3 luxury hotels
news.para: Ventive Hospitality, a joint venture between Panchshil Realty and Blackstone, is in discussions to acquire luxury hotels. The company aims to secure two to three hotels that will generate significant EBITDA income. Currently, Ventive Hospitality operates 14 assets, including various high-end hotel brands across India and the Maldives. Plans are underway to launch the first Ritz Carlton Reserve project in India.

news.title: China's new home prices fall again in September as recovery stays elusive
news.para: China's housing market is still under pressure as home prices dropped by 0.1% in September, marking over three years of decline. Even though some major cities are seeing a stabilization in prices, many smaller cities continue to face significant reductions. The first nine months of the year have also seen a sharp contract in both property investments and home sales.

news.title: Kochi: Crores spent on slum rehabilitation, yet P&T Colony families without homes
news.para: Residents of P&T Colony have been moved to apartments now considered unsafe, suffering from significant construction defects like cracked walls and wastewater leaks. Families consistently raise alarms with the Greater Cochin Development Authority, but progress remains stagnant. Compounding their plight are bureaucratic hold-ups in issuing vital certificates for other families, leaving many still in limbo. Despite ongoing discussions, a resolution seems distant for those impacted.

news.title: Himachal Pradesh HC flags illegal-height Barog projects, seeks 10-year state-wide land deal data
news.para: The Himachal Pradesh high court has instructed the government to furnish an in-depth report on land purchase permits. Concerns were voiced about towering multi-storey structures breaching height regulations in Barog, Solan district. The court seeks clarity on permissions issued under Section 118 of the HP Tenancy and Land Reforms Act and demands transparency on both approved and rejected applications.

news.title: Joint property owners in Bengaluru can now split A-eKhata online, get separate records
news.para: In a bid to simplify property management, the Greater Bengaluru Authority has unveiled an online service designed for joint property owners. With this service, holders of joint A-eKhatas can easily obtain distinct e-khatas, enabling them to handle their property affairs on their own. A sub-division fee based on the guidance value will be implemented. This effort seeks to streamline property transactions in Bengaluru, reducing the need for extensive manual processes.

news.title: Pune cantonment residents oppose draft building bylaws, demand uniform FSI of two
news.para: Citizens and activists in Pune are voicing their dissent regarding the draft building bylaws that received approval from the DGDE. The latest proposals suggest a four-tier classification for permissible floor space index, deviating from a uniform FSI of 2. Activists are pushing for clarity on the standards used to set FSI limits in residential neighborhoods, particularly as many property owners encounter challenges due to vague construction restrictions.

news.title: Delhi civic body's survey identifies over 21,000 properties operating commercially in residential zones
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has identified over 21,000 properties engaged in commercial activities within residential areas. Actions against violations of land-use norms have been initiated following a Supreme Court order. Approximately 12,000 properties have paid conversion charges, while 9,000 remain non-compliant. Sealing actions have begun in specific zones, including Central and Rohini. The survey will continue in unauthorized colonies and areas benefiting from the PM-UDAY scheme.

news.title: India Cements' profit multifold to ₹38.82 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: India Cements Ltd, part of the UltraTech Cement group, has reported a remarkable surge in its net profit for the September quarter, soaring to Rs 38.82 crore from Rs 8.81 crore the previous year. Revenue from operations increased to Rs 1,142.03 crore, while domestic sales volume grew by 16.2 percent, reaching 2.83 million tonnes. Furthermore, the board has greenlit the relocation of the registered office from Tamil Nadu to Maharashtra.

news.title: DHBVN directs ATS Triumph's developer to separate power, upkeep charges
news.para: Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam has ordered ATS Triumph to create a unified billing format for residents. This directive comes after the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission identified issues with billing methods and infrastructure. The developer is expected to delineate maintenance and diesel generator fees in bills to safeguard against disconnections. Compliance deadlines have been established to foster transparency and address customer concerns more efficiently.
